description: Surfaced by the fz-go4.18.23 audit (2026-07-02): fixture_matrix has ~27 pre-existing failures at BOTH 014aa505f and its parent on fz-go4.1/frontdoor-cli-ownership (byte-identical outputs at both commits — NOT caused by the recent .18.x work, but the lib-only gate means matrix state hasn't been part of recent evidence).
